svg.title: tsrs vs bun check vs tsgo
svg.desc: Summed over 17 TypeScript projects · 4 threads each · 16-vCPU Linux machine. Check time: tsrs 12.2 s, bun check 36.8 s, tsgo 80.7 s. Peak memory: tsrs 12.6 GiB, bun check 15.3 GiB, tsgo 53.6 GiB. Shorter is better. Per project: vscode: tsrs 2.17 s, 1.80 GiB; bun check 4.33 s, 1.50 GiB; tsgo 10.60 s, 7.57 GiB. xstate-main: tsrs 0.16 s, 0.24 GiB; bun check 0.31 s, 0.30 GiB; tsgo 0.86 s, 0.72 GiB. webpack: tsrs 0.26 s, 0.40 GiB; bun check 0.49 s, 0.37 GiB; tsgo 1.30 s, 1.17 GiB. mui-docs: tsrs 1.08 s, 1.05 GiB; bun check 9.73 s, 5.29 GiB; tsgo 12.91 s, 7.60 GiB. Compiler: tsrs 0.06 s, 0.10 GiB; bun check 0.11 s, 0.12 GiB; tsgo 0.27 s, 0.21 GiB. Compiler-Unions: tsrs 0.10 s, 0.10 GiB; bun check 0.22 s, 0.13 GiB; tsgo 0.57 s, 0.23 GiB. cal-diy: tsrs 0.98 s, 1.14 GiB; bun check 3.02 s, 0.93 GiB; tsgo 5.50 s, 4.38 GiB. formbricks-web: tsrs 1.22 s, 1.45 GiB; bun check 2.52 s, 1.34 GiB; tsgo 7.35 s, 5.85 GiB. supabase-studio: tsrs 1.22 s, 1.20 GiB; bun check 3.55 s, 0.89 GiB; tsgo 6.72 s, 4.82 GiB. t3code-server: tsrs 1.65 s, 1.18 GiB; bun check 3.78 s, 1.01 GiB; tsgo 14.22 s, 6.20 GiB. mikro-orm: tsrs 1.57 s, 1.40 GiB; bun check 4.78 s, 0.76 GiB; tsgo 10.04 s, 6.45 GiB. next-packages-next: tsrs 0.44 s, 0.55 GiB; bun check 0.92 s, 0.50 GiB; tsgo 3.09 s, 1.77 GiB. next-root: tsrs 0.28 s, 0.40 GiB; bun check 0.60 s, 0.42 GiB; tsgo 1.50 s, 1.30 GiB. storybook: tsrs 0.26 s, 0.39 GiB; bun check 0.52 s, 0.45 GiB; tsgo 1.63 s, 1.38 GiB. nuxt: tsrs 0.24 s, 0.38 GiB; bun check 0.68 s, 0.40 GiB; tsgo 1.24 s, 1.16 GiB. playwright: tsrs 0.21 s, 0.34 GiB; bun check 0.43 s, 0.37 GiB; tsgo 1.11 s, 1.08 GiB. drizzle-orm: tsrs 0.28 s, 0.50 GiB; bun check 0.77 s, 0.53 GiB; tsgo 1.81 s, 1.74 GiB. tsgo and tsrs with --checkers 4, bun check with --threads 4. Median of 10 interleaved runs (3 for tsgo). tsrs uses PGO-optimized dist build, built like the npm release binaries. Machine: Depot CI depot-ubuntu-24.04-16 (16 vCPU, 63 GB RAM, Linux x86_64, AMD EPYC 9R45 96-Core Processor). Measured 2026-10-16 09:14 UTC; tsrs commit 77a90f9df8ba1471382e0b8dd3ff8e6f5d7d2d96. TypeScript 7.0.2; TypeScript reference b85298b6a81f772d080b0455de0ca9d744cd6fd6.
